messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I pushed a change to runtime-config that renames field `route_priority` -> `priority_hint`. Console still sends `route_priority`, and `config apply` is returning 409s this morning.

dan: Oof, saw alerts. Any crash loops?

maria: Not crash loops, but ~2% of applies are failing with conflict. Example payload and response:
```http
POST /v1/runtime/apply
{
  \"route_priority\": \"high\",
  ...
}

HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
{\"error\":\"field mismatch\", \"field\":\"route_priority\"}
```

nisha: Is this only for apply endpoints or also the preview/diff API?

maria: Both. Preview rejects same payload. I can revert the rename but want to evaluate compatibility strategy.

kevin: We should not require the console to change immediately. Two safe options: server-side accept both keys (transform), or add a short compatibility shim on the gateway that maps `route_priority` -> `priority_hint`.

julie: Love shim approach + telemetry. Add a metric for "compat.accepted_old_field" so we can track usage and know when it's safe to remove.

maria: Agreed. I can add transform in the runtime reconcile service and a feature flag to gate it (ff.runtime.accept_old_priority). Then we can flip the flag on for all customers for 2 weeks, monitor, and then start per-customer opt-out window before removal.

dan: Two practical asks: 1) ensure the console shows a visible migration warning when it sends the old field, so product owns the UX. 2) console should emit telemetry that it migrated a field so we have source-side signals.

nisha: For (1) we can add a non-blocking banner in the config editor: "Using deprecated field route_priority; we'll migrate automatically. Update to priority_hint." Link to docs. For (2) console already emits `config.submit` events; we can add property `used_deprecated_field: true`.

kevin: Also watch quota and routing policy coupling — if priority_hint changes routing decisions (cost vs latency), we need a rollout plan per cohort. The transform should preserve semantics exactly, no interpretation changes.

maria: Checked semantics: I only renamed the key in the protobuf; value enum stayed identical. Transform is purely rename.

julie: Ops plan: maria adds shim + feature flag. We deploy to canary, enable for 10% of accounts, watch `config.apply_conflict`, `compat.accepted_old_field`, and `config.regressions` dashboards. If stable, expand to 50% then 100%. Keep flag on for 14 days. Then announce removal window 30 days later.

maria: Sounds good. I'll open a small PR for the transform + ff. One implementation Q: do we add the transform in the edge gateway or in the reconcile service? Edge is faster to patch but we prefer server-side for single-source-of-truth and testing. Thoughts?

dan: Server-side is better for deterministic audits and for retries. If gateway mutates payloads we lose original in logs unless we add x-original-payload headers. But server-side can log both forms.

kevin: Another ops note: add a reconciliation comparator that tolerates key aliases so the diff view doesn't show spurious changes when console auto-migrates. Otherwise customers will see fake diffs.

maria: Good catch. I'll extend the preview/diff codepath to normalize aliases before diffing.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of runtime-reconcile v2 at infra-canary succeeded (sha: a1b2c3).

nisha: Can we add a quick acceptance test to the console e2e that asserts telemetry property `used_deprecated_field` is present when posting old payload?

maria: Yes. I'll add it.

julie: Telemetry dashboard items:
- Timeseries: `compat.accepted_old_field` per-account
- Percent of config applies that required compat transform
- Diff churn rate (pre/post) to ensure normalization works

dan: Also add an alert if transforms spike >1% in an hour; could indicate a release regression or a broken rollout.

kevin: One more API-debate: should the server respond 200 with a `deprecated_field_used` warning instead of 409 in the future? That'd be more lenient but might mask schema drift. For now keep 409 to force visibility; the temporary shim will allow controlled relaxation.

maria: Agreed. We'll keep strict errors until shim is in place and migration metrics look good.

julie: I'll draft a short ops runbook and customer comms blurb for the deprecation window. If anyone wants to add wording ping me.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/reconcile/pull/421 — includes transform, ff flag, unit tests, and preview normalization. I'll add the console telemetry PR after lunchtime.

nisha: Thanks — lemme know if you want help with the dashboards.

maria: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
